claim: The row lists 81; 88 people, online_rct/other designs, and creative_writing/other tasks among the randomized studies.
problem: The 88-person entry is a separate formative survey, not a randomized AI-assistance experiment. Only the order of survey scenarios was randomized; respondents received no AI assistance and produced no scored creative output. Including this survey adds an inapplicable experimental sample and its design/task labels to the row. For the randomized AI-assistance study, these cells should read 81, online_rct, and creative_writing.
